entry.title: dotnet/sdk - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-10-05
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Blazor publish tests fail when Static Web Assets copy paths exceed MAX_PATH #56500
  • SupportedOSPlatformVersion test fails when editorconfig path exceeds MAX_PATH #56499
  • FullFramework NuGet restore tests fail when test paths exceed MAX_PATH #56498
  • [vendored-sync] dotnet-test-terminal-targetframeworkparser: drift detected (#0) #56495
  • [vendored-sync] dotnet-test-terminal-testprogressstate: drift detected (#0) #56494
  • [vendored-sync] dotnet-test-terminal-reporter: drift detected (#4) #56493
  • [vendored-sync] dotnet-test-terminal-reporter: drift detected (#1) #56492
  • [vendored-sync] dotnet-test-wire-contract-fieldids: drift detected (#0) #56491

Closed

  • [NETSDKE2E][Regression] Failed to install NET11 RC2 SDK in a custom location. #56112
  • Self-contained windows-targeting app cannot be packed #56443

PullRequests

Created

  • Ignore manifest folders without WorkloadManifest.json when merging manifest roots #56509
  • [release/10.0.2xx] Update `.editorconfig` template to set `dotnet_separate_import_directive_groups` to `false` #56508
    backport
  • `dotnetup` Perf: Replace .NET Tar with `bsdtar` in Windows #56507
  • Remove VersionOverride from Releases package reference #56506
    Servicing-consider
  • Identify ownership blocker for Visual Studio .slnx template detection #56505
  • Upgrade gh-aw action lock to v0.90.3 #56504
  • Shorten Windows desktop test project path #56503
  • [release/11.0.2xx] Allow RID-specific self-contained Windows tools to be packed #56502
    Area-Tools, backport
  • Preserve NuGet credential-provider discovery for sudo workload commands #56501
  • File-based apps: propagate PreferredUILang in csc-only fast path #56497
    Area-run-file

Merged

  • Update `.editorconfig` template to set `dotnet_separate_import_directive_groups` to `false` #50476
    Area-Infrastructure, Area-Common templates
  • [release/10.0.1xx] Backport Helix Job Monitor support #56277
  • Allow RID-specific self-contained Windows tools to be packed #56444
    Area-Tools

Updated

  • Fix zsh/fish completions emitting invalid Windows-style option switches #55466
  • Add `dotnetup self update` command #55511
  • Expand optimized publish to conservative trimmed app scenarios #56484
  • [release/10.0.4xx] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #56473
  • Normalize package pseudo-locale satellite casing consistently #56485
  • Notify when a newer dotnetup is available #56442
  • Add BundledRuntimeAssetRuntimeIdentifiers to filter runtimes/ folder assets by RID allow-list #53140
    Partner request, Document for new feature, Area-NetSDK, 11.0.1xx
  • Update common project templates to net12.0 #56404
  • Add shared CLI string resource runtime #56387
  • Measure CLI activities and MSBuild submission durations #56402
  • [wasm] Migrate BlazorWebAssembly tests to CoreCLR #56461
  • Add dotnet sdk add and dotnet sdk remove commands #54577
    Area-CLI
  • File-based apps: allow metadata on `#:include` #56392
    Area-run-file
